7.7.23 Previously Active Service Only DTCs (DM54)
The DM54 message reports previously active service only DTCs.
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00180] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈On reception of request for DM54 (call of J1939Dcm_RequestIndication with parameter requestedPgn set according to table column “PGN (Hexadecimal)” in [SWS_J1939Dcm_00238]) the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall use the common “DTC status” sequence with the parameters DTCStatusFilter, DTCOrigin, and DTCKind set according to the corresponding table columns in
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00236].⌋ The common “DTC status” sequence is described in Chapter 7.6.1.
[SWS_J1939Dcm_00181] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04112
⌈The return values J1939DTC and OccurenceCounter shall be encoded into the DM54 layout according to SAE J1939-73.⌋
